video.title: AI欧腐《请把我压制在地，我的宿敌/Please Pin Me Down My Rival》
video.desc:
昨晚上就看到了睡醒翻一翻
Julian and Xavier, the ace players of the Eastern and Western Conferences, respectively, are the league’s acknowledged archrivals. Julian had planned to propose to his girlfriend, Irene, but caught her publicly confessing her love to Xavier. To get back at the “scoundrel couple,” Julian vowed to seduce Xavier, make him fall in love with her, and then dump him ruthlessly.However, he didn’t know that Xavier had no interest in Irene at all—the true prey he’d been coveting all along was Julian himself, from start to finish. Forced to share a room, a bathroom, and the battlefield, Xavier’s pathological possessiveness closed in step by step, and Julian’s plan for revenge gradually spiraled out of control.When the locker room door swings open, when the necklace is taken into his mouth, when the sliding tackle lands on the field—he can’t tell whether Xavier’s every advance means the prey has taken the bait, or if he himself is gradually falling into the trap.

Julian 与 Xavier 分别是东、西部联盟的王牌球员，也是联盟公认的头号死对头。Julian 原本打算向女友 Irene 求婚，却撞见她当众向 Xavier 表白。为了报复这对"狗男女"，Julian 发誓要勾引 Xavier，让他爱上自己，再狠狠地甩了他。
然而他并不知道，Xavier 对 Irene 根本毫无兴趣——他从头到尾觊觎的真正猎物，一直都是 Julian 本人。被迫同住一室、共用一间浴室、同踏一片赛场，Xavier 近乎病态的占有欲步步逼近，而 Julian 的复仇计划也渐渐失控。
当更衣室的门被推开，当项链被含进口中，当铲球在球场上落下——他已分不清，Xavier 的每一次逼近，究竟是猎物上钩了，还是自己正一步步落入圈套。
